title: Stellar Forge Bounty Marketplace
features: Marketplace frontend with searchable XLM/USDC bounties, filters, detailed acceptance criteria and lifecycle, demo wallet identity, claim/PR-submission/review simulation, draft creation and scoped advisory template.
limits: Static frontend instead of Next.js/API/Soroban backend. Every balance, escrow status and transaction is fictional; no wallet extension/signature/keys/network calls, no GitHub verification or real AI. Release is only a local state demonstration, never a financial action.
